description: Frigate is a free, open-source Network Video Recorder (NVR) with realtime local object detection for IP cameras. It ingests RTSP camera streams (via its bundled go2rtc engine), records video, and detects people/vehicles/animals without sending footage to the cloud.
name: frigate
note: Requires a config.yml in the config volume defining your cameras' RTSP streams (e.g. rtsp://IP-CAM/ch0_1.h264 for detection, ch0_0.h264 for recording). This container needs a larger shared-memory allocation than Portainer's default 64MB — after deploying, edit the container/stack to add `shm_size: 512m` (or more) or detection will crash.
title: Frigate NVR
